events.title: Sunday Member’s Draws
events.description: @ Spend your Sunday at Club Helensvale and be part of the excitement with our Sunday Members Draw. Draws take place at 2pm, 3pm and 4pm, giving you three chances to win. If the major prize isn’t won, enjoy Spin the Wheel consolation draws for even more opportunities to take home a prize. Simply swipe at the kiosk each Sunday to enter. The jackpot increases by $200 every week! Plus, enjoy live entertainment from 2pm to 5pm and meat raffles from 1:30pm, making Sunday the perfect day to relax and win at Club Helensvale. T&Cs apply.
